strategy.thesis: Canada's national pension fund (C$793B AUM) invests directly into late-stage/growth private-company rounds across all sectors from its own balance sheet; no dedicated healthcare team is named publicly, but it has repeatedly led or joined large growth rounds for health/biotech companies as part of its diversified private-equity allocation (33% of AUM).

summary.en: Toronto-headquartered manager of Canada's C$793B national pension reserve, investing directly into late-stage private rounds worldwide; no dedicated health team, but a real repeat pattern of health/biotech growth investing (Kry/Livi, Insitro, Seaport Therapeutics, Sana Biotechnology, Deep Genomics) across 5 companies in this directory.
